categories.styles: Style mining + STYLES.md curation (taste discovery from PSD/PSB corpus)
categories.pipeline: Ingest / score / route / report pipeline at scale
categories.taste-engine: Feedback loop: matching processed files back to source NEFs
categories.scoring: Vision API scoring quality, resumption, parallelism

features.name: Promote styles_draft.md to STYLES.md
features.description: Review the 9 auto-named clusters in .bridge-assist/styles/styles_draft.md. Walk each via `bridge-assist styles-inspect <id>`. Rename, split cinematic-fantasy-composite (347 files) if visual inspection finds sub-styles, decide on cluster -1 (HDBSCAN noise bucket, 163 files), merge near-duplicates. Then cp draft to project-root STYLES.md, edit voice to match taste.md, commit, open PR.
features.test_criteria: STYLES.md exists at project root, committed, and reviewed by human. Each style has a coherent name, intent, signals, signature moves, and at least one example output reference.

features.name: Run route + report on Hawaii 2026 scored data
features.description: Scores exist (scores-hawaii-2026.json, 499 images). Execute `bridge-assist route --taste ./taste.md --tag hawaii-2026` and `bridge-assist report --taste ./taste.md --tag hawaii-2026` to complete the pipeline and validate the per-channel contact-sheet layout at real scale.
features.test_criteria: `.bridge-assist/routes-hawaii-2026/` populated with channel folders containing symlinks + derivatives; `sort-report-hawaii-2026.md` renders without errors and shows reasonable channel distributions.

features.name: Fix D800 EXIF extraction (Nikon-specific fields)
features.description: Sort reports currently show `Unknownmm f/Unknown ISO Unknown` for some test images. exiftool integration (commit 0fafe74) should resolve this. Verify exiftool is installed and being called on the Hawaii run; if EXIF is still missing, trace the ingest code path.
features.test_criteria: Sort report for Hawaii 2026 shows focal length, aperture, and ISO for at least 95% of images. Smoke test on MT88026 image returns non-Unknown values.

features.name: End-to-end test of feedback loop with real processed files
features.description: Phase 1 of the taste engine is built (`record`, `record-dir`, `feedback`) but has not been tested with real processed PSDs (Photoshop) or TIFs (Capture One). Process a handful of Hawaii images through the actual NX-D / Photoshop workflow, then run `bridge-assist record-dir` and verify the channel inference + match logic works against live data.
features.test_criteria: At least 10 real processed files (PSD + TIF mix) recorded; feedback.db contains correct source-NEF matches, inferred channels match human expectation in >=80% of cases, and `feedback --summary` shows non-empty per-channel stats.

features.name: Verify --only-unscored resumption
features.description: The `--only-unscored` flag exists in the score command. Verify it correctly skips already-scored images when resuming a partially-completed run. Kill a run mid-flight, resume with `--only-unscored`, confirm zero duplicate API calls and that the merged scores file is correct.
features.test_criteria: After interrupting a score run at ~50% and resuming with `--only-unscored`, the final scores.json contains entries for all images, no image is scored twice, and total API spend approximates 50% of a clean run.

features.name: Evaluate batch/parallel scoring
features.description: At ~9 seconds per image, 499 images took 75 minutes. Investigate whether the Anthropic API supports safe concurrent requests and whether batching 3-5 images in parallel reduces wall-clock without hitting rate limits or degrading score quality.
features.test_criteria: Benchmarked side-by-side on a 50-image subset: serial vs. parallel. Parallel run produces identical scores (within noise) and at least 2x wall-clock speedup, with no API errors.

features.name: Expand unit test coverage beyond taste discovery
features.description: tests/test_taste_discovery.py covers the new style-mining pipeline (16 tests, passing). Other core modules have no tests. Priority targets: `taste_parser.py` (parse/validate taste.md), `tagged_filename()` helper in cli.py, `parse_scores_response()` JSON extraction in score.py, `_confidence_bar()` in report.py.
features.test_criteria: New test files: tests/test_taste_parser.py, tests/test_score.py, tests/test_cli_helpers.py, tests/test_report.py. Total project test count >=35. `python -m pytest tests/ -v` exits 0.

features.name: Extend DECISIONS.md (consolidate architectural rationale)
features.description: File now exists at project root with one entry (public-mirror strategy, 2026-05-09, format: Decision / Why / Rejected alternatives / Consequences / Files-that-must-stay-out). Backfill the rest: single-call multi-channel scoring, Claude > OpenAI for taste scoring, symlinks not copies, per-channel report layout, page-scoped XMP labels, working-dir-at-cwd, size-guard threshold for >1GB PSBs.
features.test_criteria: DECISIONS.md contains at least 5 numbered/dated decisions, each with Decision / Why / Consequences sections, and is linked from README.md.

features.name: Declare pytest as a dev dependency in pyproject.toml
features.description: pytest is not in pyproject.toml or requirements.txt. Was installed manually into .venv on 2026-05-21 to run the existing 16-test suite. Add a `[project.optional-dependencies] dev = ["pytest>=8"]` block and document `pip install -e .[dev]` in README/CLAUDE.md.
features.test_criteria: Fresh venv created via `python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e .[dev]` can run `python -m pytest tests/ -v` without additional installs.
